dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the upper-right dorsal surface. These features exhibit sharp, high-intensity white perimeters with a rapid gradient transition into darker, low-intensity centers, particularly in the three most distal rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters is located along the lower-right lateral edge and the base of the rear flipper. These clusters appear as asymmetrical, solid-filled blobs without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three prominent 'O' rings on the upper dorsal area form a scalene triangle. An additional linear relationship is formed by four smaller high-contrast points aligned along the mid-dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, branching network of jagged, high-intensity white lines connects multiple macro-annuli across the central dorsal region, creating a map-like filamentary structure.
